_about: Single source of truth for Stroom. Edit here, then run scripts/sync_shared.sh. Money in EUR per kWh.

tariff._source: Eneco Dynamisch HollandseWind & Zon E. Markup derived 14 Sep 2026 from two live prices in Mijn Eneco (0.42834 and 0.39031) minus spot x 1.21 minus energy tax; both hours give 0.02296.

tiers._source: Calibrated on Sep 2025 - Sep 2026 hourly prices with scripts/calibrate_thresholds.py. Free = market price at or below zero.
tiers._minWindowHours: Cheap or expensive stretches shorter than this are not shown (free ones always are). Added 14 Sep 2026 after a lone 04:00 cheap hour.
